reviews.title: There is no true “free version”
reviews.text: When anyone complains about the price in the review section the automated response is that they are not required to pay and there is a free version, this is a lie. The “free version” is when u just don’t pay or sign up for a subscription but the app will no longer work after 3 days of use as everything you now click will force you to either sign up for their 3 day trial or pay their absurd prices. Just add ads or something don’t force people into paying for something that they might not even like yet.
